Vodka over ice topped with tart cranberry juice and a squeeze of fresh lime.

ops.sub: Vodka shaken hard with orange liqueur, cranberry and fresh lime, strained into chilled coupes with a flamed orange twist. Chill 4 coupes. For each drink, shake 40ml vodka, 15ml orange liqueur, 30ml cranberry juice and 15ml lime juice with plenty of ice for 15 seconds. Strain into the coupes. Hold a strip of orange peel over each glass, warm it with a match and squeeze so the oil flashes, then drop it in.
ops.to: Vodka poured over ice and topped with tart cranberry juice and a squeeze of fresh lime. Fill 4 highball glasses with ice. Pour 45ml vodka into each, top with 120ml cranberry juice and squeeze in a lime wedge.
